summary: Standard Lithium Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release about its Smackover Lithium joint venture awarding an EPCM contract for the South West Arkansas well field. The agreement with Wood Group covers engineering, procurement, and construction management for well pads, pipelines, and related infrastructure. The project targets 22,500 tonnes per annum of lithium carbonate. No financial terms, equity considerations, or strategic changes are disclosed. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation. No deal terms, board actions, or M&A mechanics are present; the filing simply contracts a service provider ahead of a final investment decision.
